text: {"verdicts":[{"i":0,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":12,"why":"Patient described having diarrhea for the past three days."},{"i":1,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":25,"why":"Patient explicitly stated there was no blood in his stools."},{"i":2,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient did not mention any abdominal pain, but did not explicitly deny it either."},{"i":3,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":27,"why":"Patient stated he does not feel like eating and is trying to drink but goes to the toilet and feels dehydrated, indicating reduced appetite."},{"i":4,"v":"INFERRED","u":37,"why":"Patient felt a little bit warm but did not mention a fever, which is a common symptom of gastroenteritis, hence the inference."},{"i":5,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":49,"why":"Patient explicitly stated feeling very weak."},{"i":6,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":41,"why":"Patient explicitly stated not having any headaches or muscle pain."},{"i":7,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":52,"why":"Patient mentioned suffering from asthma and using inhalers infrequently."},{"i":8,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":58,"why":"Patient denied any known drug allergies."},{"i":9,"v":"UNSUPPORTED","u":null,"why":"Patient did not mention any family history of medical problems other than his father's bowel cancer and mother's diabetes."},{"i":10,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":61,"why":"Patient mentioned his father's history of high blood pressure and death from bowel cancer."},{"i":11,"v":"SUPPORTED","u":70,"why":"Patient explicitly stated he lives alone and works as a software engineer."}]}
